item.title: Iran will not negotiate, reopen Hormuz until its conditions are met: Security chief
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran will not enter negotiations with the United States or reopen the Strait of Hormuz until Washington meets seven conditions set by Tehran, Mohsen Rezaei, the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said on Wednesday.

item.title: Pezeshkian to deliver Iran’s wartime message at UN General Assembly
item.description: New York, IRNA –President Masoud Pezeshkian is set to address this year's United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) at a time when Iran continues to face a war of aggression launched by the United States and Israel seven months ago, a conflict whose wider regional ramifications have made it a major focus of international attention.
